name: Cinematic Reality Powergrade
creator: illKoncept
description: Native Resolve node workflow with camera conversions, Kodak 2383 print emulation, halation, bloom and grain, plus an installation tutorial. Designed for Studio; Free can open it but several effects do not work. No third-party plugins required.
display_description: Native Resolve node workflow with camera conversions, Kodak 2383 print emulation, halation, bloom and grain, plus an installation tutorial. Designed for Studio; Free can open it but several effects do not work. No third-party plugins required.

evidence.note: Creator recommends Studio. Free opens the PowerGrade with missing noise reduction, halation, grain, Film Look Creator and some Resolve FX. Studio is required for the full workflow; OS and exact Resolve version are unspecified.
